notes: Download-only base: the clean zip is 73 MB, far too large to commit (the other base zips here are 0.7-6.8 MB). apply_overlay supports this for upstreams with stable per-version archive paths. If Nanomani ever prunes old versions the overlay is still trivially re-derivable: it is a single-line DELETION, described in full below. base_zip_local points at a gitignored copy: present on a dev box for fast rebuilds, absent in CI where it falls through to base_zip_url.
changelog:
0.0.3 - Add the GearsAI subtitles ("Wand") button to the player OSD.
Rounded was the only skin in the build with no reference to
service.subtitles.gearsai at all. Added as a button in the OSD subtitles
submenu (id 9326), same RunScript(...,sub_window) call Zephyr uses, hidden
when the addon is absent or on LiveTV / music videos.

0.0.2 - Pin the skin font to NotoSans Regular (settingskinfont=11).
It is the only one of the skin's eleven fontsets containing a Hebrew face;
the skin's setup wizard lets the user choose a font and runs AFTER anything
we seed into addon_data, so seeding could not hold it. Re-asserted on every
Home load, which fires as soon as the setup wizard closes. Only the font is
forced; every other setup choice stays the user's.

0.0.1 - Initial overlay. Removes ONE line from 1080i/Home.xml:
    <onload>RunScript(script.skinshortcuts,type=buildxml)</onload>
Home.xml calls buildxml TWICE on load: line 12 with the real parameters (mainmenuID=300, group=mainmenu|x1111..x1119|powermenu|searchmenulist, levels=10) and line 13 with none, which defaults to levels=0. The two race; whichever finishes last wins. When the bare one won it overwrote the full 324 KB includes with a 20 KB level-0-only file containing no skinshortcuts-template-widgets and no -1 submenu groups, so EVERY widget row silently failed to load and kodi.log said 'Skin has invalid include: skinshortcuts-template-widgets'.
Measured 2026-08-29: with the line present the result alternates between 324334 and 20154 bytes across boots; with it removed, three consecutive boots with the hash cleared all produced 324334.
This is an upstream bug (the line is present in clean 1.3.00) and should be reported to Nanomani so the overlay can be dropped.
